Thanks for bringing your bot! Partial answers are welcome; we can work through
packaging together. Please avoid posting private credentials or correspondence.

- Bot name, description, author/team, and preferred attribution:
- Source repository and recommended version/commit:
- License and third-party dependencies/assets:
- Supported races and formats (1v1, teams, FFA), map restrictions:
- BWAPI version, build instructions, native/Java runtime and architecture:
- Expected skill/play style and any published results:
- Persistent learning, saved results, caches, logs, and their locations:
- Network access, child processes, installers, or unusual system requirements:
- Any existing source patches needed for ShieldBattery:
- Intended availability: local play, online custom games, public ladder/tournaments:
- Any use/distribution restrictions or permissions we should discuss:

We review source and runtime behavior before distributing a package. Local
inclusion does not automatically authorize public competition submissions.
